text: That is confusing, as Iron Deficiency Anemia does not typically cause non-blanching petechiae (those pinpoint red spots). DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Leukemia (likely Acute Myeloid Leukemia or Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia)

The combination of severe anemia (Hb 8.3), thrombocytopenia (Platelets 35,600), and marked leukocytosis (WBC 81,000) alongside the presence of blast cells and Auer rods (needle-shaped inclusions) on the smear is diagnostic of leukemia.
